items.title: Is Solid Tumor Partnership Altering The Investment Case For AbbVie (ABBV)?
items.summary: AbbVie and German biotech Disco Pharmaceuticals announced a collaboration to co-develop AND gated bispecific therapies for solid tumors, with Disco receiving US$40 million upfront and eligibility for up to US$2.5 billion in milestones plus tiered royalties. The deal adds external oncology technology on top of AbbVie’s internal research programs, indicating an effort to broaden its solid tumor pipeline beyond its current immunology heavy revenue base.
